'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Joe Olson LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' ARebelSpy
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
